name: Southern Magnesium & Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Southern Magnesium & Chemicals Ltd is in the business of Magnesium Metal and related goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SMCL is promoted by Dr. N B Prasad and family. It set up a project at Gowripatnam, Andhra Pradesh, to manufacture magnesium metal, in a joint venture with the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Development Corporation. It was the first and only company in India to commercially produce Magnesium Metal

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 41.9%
Debtor days have improved from 53.8 to 15.6 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
